notes: Clans instead of teams: up to 10 players under one leader, open or by request (founding a clan unlocks at level 8)
Clan season track: your clan's steps fill a line of milestones, and each one puts a chest into the clan vault
Clan vault: the leader pays chests out as salary to the members they choose
Clan leaderboard: Ranking → Clans, Today / Week / Season
New inventory grid: drag to arrange, tap to open, use or gift
Gifts and live trades between players (Ready, then Accept on both sides)
Boosts no longer expire, higher item limits
One account per phone, strictly: moving to a new phone takes 3 days and the old phone can cancel it; Settings → Delete account frees the phone
